topic.title: Love Calculator
topic.description: A fun program that counts letters in "true" and "love" from two names and produces a love score. Practices string methods and conditionals.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Using str.lower() for case-insensitive matching and str.count() to tally characters.
learningNotes.challenges: Correctly concatenating the two names before counting.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Improve scoring algorithm and add more words.

files.description: Calculates a love score from two names.
